title: Numbers to 20
seo_title: Numbers to 20 – Kindergarten Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Say, read and write numbers 0 to 20; know the order of numbers; find the number before and after. (summary of the NERDC Kindergarten Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free kindergarten maths worksheets for Nigeria: read and write numbers to 20, number names, what comes next, and teen numbers. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Numbers go up by one each time
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Count on: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 … up to 20.
  • The number after is one more. The number before is one less.
  • 13 is 10 and 3 more.

Examples

Example

What comes after 14?

14, 15

Answer: 15

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Writing 12 as 21The 1 (one ten) comes first: 12.
Mixing up 13 and 30Thirteen is 13. Thirty is 30.
Missing a numberSay every number in order.
